name: track-switch-sampling
description: Sampled-mode behaviour of the input sampling switch at 1 MS/s with the real 8.83 pF CDAC array load: worst-case acquisition settling, charge injection / clock feedthrough vs ratiometric input level, and hold droop. T-gate at two sizes and dummy-compensated T-gate; the bootstrapped-switch branches (bs10/bs20) are disabled in the netlist per DR-0007 (bootstrap rejected; its internal feedback loop dominated simulation cost by >10x). Extended for #39 with a dummy-to-main width-ratio sweep (0.50/0.70/0.85) and a bare-drive source-impedance sweep (10/20/30/50/150/500 ohm) of the DR-0007 switch, to separate the dummy's sizing from the drive condition that sets the turn-off charge split; four external-shunt-capacitor branches (100 pF and 1 nF, each at 25 and 500 ohm) that test whether a shunt capacitor at the input pin pins that split; and a candidate compliant configuration (25 ohm + 1 nF drive network, dummy ratio re-tuned to 7/16) measured at 1, 25 and 500 ohm with a 1 nF pin capacitor and at 1, 250 and 500 ohm with a 100 pF one (the same input time constant, a larger allowed source impedance), each with a worst-case acquisition step.
claim: README.md#target-specification -- gain error (<= 0.5 LSB), offset (<= 2 LSB), INL/DNL and SFDR contributions of the sampling switch, and the input-structure row's settling/droop numbers.
analyses: tran 200p 2u 0 200p
